author: brossow
releaseNotes: Thermostat: the hub home page now shows a real thermostat tile instead of "Unknown device type", with current temperature, both setpoints and working controls. Operating state is read from the unit's own running status, so it reports cooling, heating or fan only correctly in auto mode and returns to idle when nothing is running. Fan-only mode can now actually be selected — from the home page tile, and from a new fanOnly command available to dashboards and Rule Machine. Thanks to Mark Silva (texasaggie97) for the capability and operating-state fixes.
